name: Battle of Kulikovo
summary: Dmitry Donskoy, Grand Prince of Moscow, leads a Russian coalition force against the Golden Horde's army under Mamai on the Kulikovo field (near the Don River) on September 8, 1380. The Russian forces win a bloody victory; Mamai's army is destroyed. Moscow is nevertheless sacked by Khan Tokhtamysh two years later (1382), and tribute payment resumes. But Kulikovo's symbolic importance is decisive: it establishes that Russian forces can defeat the Mongols in open battle and makes Moscow the champion of Russian independence.

_quarry.structural_significance: First major Russian military victory over the Mongols; establishes Moscow's role as the leader of Russian resistance; mythologized as the beginning of the end of the Mongol/Tatar yoke
